What I searched and tried (no readable passage with the refund was available):

- Grep over project/docs for "tax summary" and for "refund" (case-insensitive) — no matches.

- Bash/ls: inspected project/docs/tax and confirmed the file name tax-summary-2023.docx is present.

- Read attempts on project/docs/tax/tax-summary-2023.docx failed (file path resolution error: "is not a file").

Because the tax-summary-2023.docx could not be read/indexed, I cannot extract the refund amount. If you want, you can (a) provide a readable PDF/ TXT export of tax-summary-2023.docx, or (b) fix/restore the .docx so I can add and query it.
